targets.rawSql:
SELECT value AS "amp_bat"
FROM amp_bat
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "volt_bat"
FROM volt_bat
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "amp_pv"
FROM amp_panel
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS volt_pv
FROM volt_panel
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "amp_load"
FROM amp_load
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "volt_load"
FROM volt_load
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "temp_pv"
FROM temp_panel 
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  value AS "temp_bat"
FROM temp_bat
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(v.value * a.value) AS power_bat
FROM volt_bat v
JOIN amp_bat a
    ON v.timestamp = a.timestamp
WHERE $__timeFilter(v.timestamp);

SELECT
    AVG(v.value * a.value) AS power_pv
FROM volt_panel v
JOIN amp_panel a
    ON v.timestamp = a.timestamp
WHERE $__timeFilter(v.timestamp);

SELECT
    AVG(v.value * a.value) AS power_load
FROM volt_load v
JOIN amp_load a
    ON v.timestamp = a.timestamp
WHERE $__timeFilter(v.timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  value,
  'PV_V' AS metric
FROM volt_panel
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT
